global_scope: Mandatory for every original-image-to-editable-PPTX job in this project.

workbench.concurrency: OCR inventory and non-text inventory run concurrently; background cleaning begins only after both inventories and masks are complete.

coordinate_contract.source_definition: pixels of the immutable 1600x900 SOURCE_REFERENCE produced by deterministic contain-with-letterbox normalization; the original file and transform are retained for audit
coordinate_contract.allowed_raw_vlm_contract: normalized_1000 + xyxy only when explicitly declared and deterministically converted

local_vlm.input: one candidate crop plus local OCR exclusions and optional gallery Top-K sheet
local_vlm.text_host_rule: OCR glyphs are text-only, but any visible container, pill, badge, card, panel, border, divider or arrow hosting them must be retained as non-text geometry. A candidate is rejected only if it has no such geometry.
local_vlm.asset_text_overlap_rule: A library/Qwen image asset may not contain readable OCR. If a visual candidate overlaps OCR, classify its nonsemantic backdrop as decorative_fixed/movable or split it before asset generation; only native hosts may enclose OCR.

classification.decorative_fixed_rule: Removal does not change data, meaning, navigation or branding; normally large, low-opacity and spanning multiple content regions.
classification.decorative_movable_rule: Pure decoration that may reasonably be moved or deleted as one independent transparent asset.

decoration_policy.fixed: extract as separate FIXED_DECOR first; merge into BG_CLEAN only after BASE_BG audit, or place on slide master/layout so it is not selectable in normal editing
decoration_policy.movable: one independently movable transparent SVG/PNG asset; internal path editability is not required

complex_asset_format_policy.ppt_insertion: insert SVG when its vector validation and local render review pass; otherwise insert the reviewed PNG

generated_asset_preflight.reference: source local crop plus declared semantic and target box
generated_asset_preflight.rejected_asset_action: keep it out of candidate PPTX; retry Qwen Image with a revised single-asset prompt or choose another gallery asset

repair_action_contract.existing_component_rule: A wrong existing native component must be replaced, never covered by a second overlay. A missing child primitive is a separate add_missing_native action.
repair_action_contract.compound_component_rule: For a visible parent-plus-child component, enumerate every visible primitive (for example: bar and its white dash) as related actions; one generic enclosing rectangle is not an acceptable substitute.

module_responsibilities.ocr_route: authoritative text content, source-pixel boxes, typography and independent text QA
module_responsibilities.candidate_detector: deterministically proposes non-text source-pixel candidates from colour, edge and component evidence after OCR masking; it does not produce final assets
module_responsibilities.vision_route: locally verifies detector candidates, hierarchy, classification, source-pixel geometry and fixed/movable decoration decisions; it never self-certifies recall from a free-form whole-slide list
module_responsibilities.mask_builder: union text/non-text/movable-decoration/shadow masks while excluding approved fixed decoration
module_responsibilities.background_cleaner: reconstruct BASE_BG only inside precise union foreground mask; never median-fill unresolved regions; emit FIXED_DECOR separately
module_responsibilities.background_auditor: OCR rescan, semantic non-text rescan, edge residual, outside-mask identity, seam and fixed-decoration completeness checks; any unresolved result blocks fusion
module_responsibilities.gallery_retriever: uses verified candidate crops only as retrieval queries; ranks Top-K by silhouette/structure/direction/style, then asks local VLM adjudication without using source crops as final assets
module_responsibilities.asset_executor: instantiate the actual native/SVG/PNG asset type rather than inserting preview PNGs; prefer a validated real-vector SVG for eligible complex assets and fall back to the reviewed transparent PNG when vector review fails
module_responsibilities.text_builder: create one visible editable object for every OCR record and split mixed value/unit runs
module_responsibilities.nontext_builder: create native components and reviewed independent assets with stable IDs, groups and z-order
module_responsibilities.route_auditor: score OCR and non-text only on their masks; never let the background inflate foreground scores
module_responsibilities.fusion_gate: merge only independently passing BASE_BG/FIXED_DECOR background route, OCR route and NONTEXT route; background failure blocks all fusion
module_responsibilities.editability_auditor: hide-layer, move, delete, source-image and shape-tree tests
module_responsibilities.repair_coordinator: missing-first top-left sweep and escalation until pass or explicit needs_review; emits explicit replace/add operation semantics, stages each action as an isolated candidate and may pass only independently proven beneficial, non-occluding actions to final fusion
module_responsibilities.vector_asset_validator: checks SVG contains real vector paths or geometry, contains no embedded raster payload, remains within complexity limits, and wins a local SVG-vs-PNG render comparison before insertion
module_responsibilities.asset_preflight_auditor: compares each Qwen-generated or gallery asset to its source local crop before candidate insertion; rejects structural, palette, scene-style, text and grid-fragment mismatches
